sources.title: GitHub - Ikracs/ArmorOCR: official repository of **ArmorOCR**
sources.snippet: This is the official inference code of ArmorOCR, a two-stage framework for grounded adversarial OCR perception via observation-transferred self-distillation and reward-driven refinement. ArmorOCR is built on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and enables single-pass inference on the original image, without any inference-time visual transformations or tool assistance.
